scope: Tiny deterministic local contracts; runtime qualification is separate.

cases.title: Establish a pure strict result
cases.input_contract: For inputs between-1000000 and 1000000, retain even values and double them in order. Preserve input and duplicates. Reject values outside the bound so Int multiplication is safe.
cases.expected: Seq(1,2,3,4) becomes Seq(4,8);Seq(0,2,2) becomes Seq(0,4,4);empty remains empty.
cases.verification: Assert the exact results, input preservation and the out-of-domain rejection.

cases.title: Locate the evaluation boundary
cases.input_contract: Return a lazy even-filter/double-map iterator with local trace messages filter:value and map:value. Validate the same numeric domain before construction. The trace should remain empty until consumption.
cases.expected: Taking one output from 1,2,3,4 yields 4 with trace filter:1, filter:2, map:2. Consuming the rest yields 8 and appends filter:3, filter:4, map:4.
cases.verification: Assert the empty initial trace, both exact output pieces and all six messages in order.

cases.title: Expose one-shot traversal state
cases.input_contract: Consume a supplied iterator into a Vector twice and return both results. Do not cache or recreate the iterator inside this function. Explain why this intentionally returns an empty second traversal.
cases.expected: A fresh iterator over 1,2,3 yields (Vector(1,2,3), Vector.empty). An already empty iterator yields two empty Vectors.
cases.verification: Assert both tuple components and the already-exhausted case.

cases.title: Provide repeatability deliberately
cases.input_contract: Return a factory creating a fresh bounded even-filter/double-map iterator on each call. Validate source values once and preserve them. Do not return the same iterator object repeatedly.
cases.expected: Two factory calls both yield Vector(4,8) for 1,2,3,4, even after the first is exhausted.
cases.verification: Consume two independently obtained iterators and assert both exact results;verify the immutable source remains unchanged.

cases.title: Separate repeated delivery from logical identity
cases.input_contract: For bounded nonnegative event amounts and nonblank IDs, compute naive delivered cents over attempts and logical once-per-ID cents when attempts>0. Reject conflicting amounts for one ID and negative attempt counts. This is a pure ledger calculation, not a real sink.
cases.expected: Records(a,100),(b,50),(a,100) with two attempts give naive 500, logical 150. Zero attempts gives (0,0);same ID with 100 and 101 is rejected.
cases.verification: Assert both totals, the zero-attempt identity and a conflicting-payload failure.

cases.title: Consume only a declared bounded prefix
cases.input_contract: Return at most limit values from an iterator, requiring 0<=limit<=1000. Support infinite iterators without collecting the whole source. Limit 0 must leave the next source value unconsumed.
cases.expected: Taking three values from Iterator.from(1) yields 1,2,3 and leaves 4 next. Limit 0 yields empty and leaves 1 next;limit 1001 is rejected.
cases.verification: Use a local next-value counter to assert three produced values, and test zero consumption and the upper-budget failure.
